title: 🌶️ Austin’s hottest tradition is back! The 36th Annual @austinchronicle Hot Sauce Festival takes over...
description: 🌶️ Austin’s hottest tradition is back! The 36th Annual @austinchronicle Hot Sauce Festival takes over @radioeastaustin on Sunday, August 30, with hundreds of hot sauce tastings, local food trucks, cold drinks, and plenty of fiery goods for sale. The festival will also feature its signature Hot Sauce Competition and People’s Choice voting, all while benefiting the Central Texas Food Bank. 📍 Radio/East, 3504 Montopolis Dr 🗓️ Sunday, August 30 ⏰ 3–9PM 🎟️ $20 presale | $25 at the door 💳 Cashless only

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...
description: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015 This happens to be our 9,000th post (hell ya) From our founder @champagnecates: Our first post ever was SLAB BBQ’s 1 year anniversary with $1 drinks and $1 sandwiches. After 11 years I can honestly say that WWW has the same heart, same ethos, same community-driven mentality from day one. I set out to change the way event-goer and event were connected. I wanted to combine my writing background and my partying background to deliver plans and news in a minimal and personable new way. I feel like we really did all that.
